idee_recherchee.texte: The Big Bang was not an explosion in space but the rapid expansion of space itself from an extremely hot and dense state about 13.8 billion years ago, and the question of what came before it remains unanswered.

titre_video: Scientists Are Freaking Out Over Space Time (It's Not Real)
titre: L'amas d'Ophiuchus et son bord incurvé
resume: The Ophiuchus galaxy cluster, 390 million light-years from Earth, intrigued scientists because of a curved edge. They suspected it was the wall of a cavity carved by plasma shot out by a huge black hole, yet assumed an explosion that big was impossible.
texte: Ophiuchus galaxy cluster, which lies 390 [music] million light-years away from Earth. The Ophiuchus galaxy had always been viewed as curious and puzzling to scientists, which [music] is why they paid it so much attention in the first place. The funny thing was it had a curved edge to it. Why could that be? Well, galaxy clusters come in all shapes and sizes, but this was particularly suspicious. So, [music] they thought that the curved edge could be the wall of a cavity caused by a huge black hole in one of the core galaxies [music] shooting out plasma, because black holes don't just suck stuff in, remember? So, the scientists had learned something, but still they assumed an explosion couldn't possibly have taken place. [music]
